ValidationRule.description: Restrict Creating Pend Task when the Date Case on Hold from is null
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_Task', ISPICKVAL(Type,'Pend Case'), OR(ISBLANK(Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c), Date_Case_on_Hold_From__c > TODAY()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create a Task when the On Hold Date is null or with a Future Date, Please create a task from Case screen with Today's Date.
